label: SearXNG
description: Web search through your own SearXNG: several engines at once, no key, no quota.
agentGuide: Web search through the user's own SearXNG (the SearXNG integration of Allkin): no key, no quota. GET /search?q=<words>&count=10 — always set count (50 at most). Optional: &categories=general|news|images|videos|it|science (one, or several separated by commas), &language=fr (a language code, or all), &time_range=day|month|year, &pageno=2 for the next page, &engines=wikipedia,github to ask named engines only. The answer: results[] with title, url, content (a snippet), published, engines, img_src / thumbnail for pictures; plus, when there are some, answers[] (a direct answer), infoboxes[] (title, content, url), suggestions[], corrections[], and unresponsive[] (the engines that did not answer, with why — a few are usual; when results is empty and many are listed, say the search engines are refusing for now and try again later rather than rephrasing ten times). Search with few, precise words like in a search engine, not a sentence. A snippet is not a source: read the page before relying on it, and cite the url of what you use. 503 with {"error": "not-ready"} means SearXNG is still installing or starting: tell the user and wait.
